title: Test suite exceeded its execution budget
message: The command was terminated after 1081s, its full 1080s execution budget. The budget expires before `timeout-minutes` so this reports as a failure instead of a cancelled job (issue #977, issue #1017). Speed up or repartition the work, or raise the budget together with the job timeout.

title: Test suite is approaching its timeout
message: The command is still running after 756s (70% of its 1080s execution budget). Speed up or repartition it before the budget terminates the step.
